issue.title: Bug: Leakage detection feature broken by newly changes

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

the change https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/776 introduces 2 issues:
1. the legacy leak_status field had been removed, instead, the leaking had been used, this db scheme is not aligned with HLD anymore, causes CLI and system-health failure since they still looking for the leak_status field
2. during initialization, there isn't any prevent of non-implemented API such as get_leak_sensor_type and get_leak_sensor_location, the FieldValuePairs does NOT accpet None as parameter which causes thread directly crash.

### Steps to Reproduce

the problem is 100% reproduce, on liquid cooling system the CLI will report liquid cooling not detected.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

feature should work as before
